{

  "ResetProfile": false
}

It will place you on streets, at fence, and should enable it for your character then. I recommend backing up your profile just in case.

Great mod! I’ve been really enjoying it.

One small issue - the config folder in the release archive begins with an uppercase C (SPT/user/mods/Vagabond/Config) while the code looks for config with a lowercase c (Config.cs:51)

Probably not an issue on Windows, but on Linux this is a problem as “Config” and “config” are considered different filenames and results in the config file not being read. Easy fix is to just rename the folder to lowercase.

The config file not being read also results in some weird defaults as it falls back on the default value of a new VagabondConfig object, which doesn’t correspond to the defaults set in the default config file (eg. VagabondConfig.EnableVirtualStashes has no default value so as a bool it will default to false) Might be a good idea to set these default values in case the config file can’t be loaded for whatever reason :)
